prompt: Build us an organizational profile approach for adopting CSF 2.0 — we're a mid-size manufacturer.
assertions: Uses all six CSF 2.0 functions including GOVERN (GV) — not the five-function 1.1 model
Distinguishes Current Profile vs Target Profile and gap analysis between them
References Implementation Tiers (1–4) as characterizing rigor of governance/risk practices, informing (not equaling) the target
Produces a prioritized action plan from the gaps (quick wins vs longer-term; owners/timelines)
Mentions using Community Profiles or Quick-Start Guides as accelerators where applicable
